title: Go around! Tower changes the plan

briefing.description: Inbound for landing — but this time the landing doesn't happen on the first try. A departing aircraft is slow to roll and Tower sends you around on short final. Go-arounds are normal, not emergencies: read back the instruction, fly the airplane, and get re-sequenced.
briefing.atisText: Centerville Regional information {atis}. Wind {wind_dir} at {wind_kt}. Visibility one zero. Sky clear. Altimeter {altimeter}. Landing and departing runway {rwy}. Advise on initial contact you have information {atis}.

steps.speaker: ATIS
steps.text: Centerville Regional information {atis}. Wind {wind_dir} at {wind_kt}. Visibility one zero. Sky clear. Altimeter {altimeter}. Landing and departing runway {rwy}. Advise on initial contact you have information {atis}.
ATIS copied. You're 10 miles {direction}, inbound. You switch to Tower.

steps.prompt: Make your initial call to Tower with position, ATIS, and intentions (full stop).
steps.hint: Centerville Tower, Skyhawk {callsign}, one zero miles {direction} with information {atis}, inbound full stop.

elements.label: your callsign
elements.feedbackMissing: Include your full callsign on initial contact.

elements.label: the ATIS code
elements.feedbackWrong: You said information {heard}, but the current ATIS is {atis}.

steps.speaker: Tower
steps.text: Skyhawk {callsign}, Centerville Tower, enter left base runway {rwy}, number one.

elements.label: pattern entry readback
elements.feedbackMissing: Read back the entry: “enter left base runway {rwy}”.

elements.label: runway readback
elements.feedbackMissing: You forgot to read back the runway assignment.
elements.feedbackWrong: You read back runway {heard}, but Tower assigned runway {rwy}.

elements.label: your callsign
elements.feedbackMissing: End the readback with your callsign.

elements.label: landing clearance readback
elements.feedbackMissing: Read back the clearance: “cleared to land”.

elements.label: runway readback
elements.feedbackMissing: Read back the runway with your clearance.
elements.feedbackWrong: You read back runway {heard}, but you're cleared for runway {rwy}.

elements.label: your callsign
elements.feedbackMissing: End the readback with your callsign.

steps.text: Short final, looking good — but the Bonanza that departed ahead is still rolling on the runway. Tower keys up, voice urgent.

steps.speaker: Tower
steps.text: Skyhawk {callsign}, go around, traffic on the runway. Fly runway heading, climb to pattern altitude.

steps.prompt: Full power, pitch for climb — and read it back. Flying comes first, but Tower needs to hear you got it.

elements.label: go-around acknowledgment
elements.feedbackMissing: Acknowledge the go-around: “going around”. Tower must know you received it — an aircraft continuing to land would be a runway conflict.

steps.text: Clean go-around — you climb out over the runway as the Bonanza finally lifts off. Tower re-sequences you.

steps.speaker: Tower
steps.text: Skyhawk {callsign}, nicely done. Enter left downwind runway {rwy}, cleared to land, number one.

steps.hint: Left downwind, cleared to land runway {rwy}, Skyhawk {callsign}.

elements.label: downwind entry
elements.feedbackMissing: Read back the pattern entry: “left downwind”.

elements.label: landing clearance readback
elements.feedbackMissing: Read back “cleared to land” — the go-around cancelled your previous clearance, this is a new one.

elements.label: runway readback
elements.feedbackWrong: You read back runway {heard}, but you're cleared for runway {rwy}.

steps.text: Second time's the charm — smooth touchdown on runway {rwy}. Go-arounds happen to everyone; handling one calmly is the mark of a real pilot.
